_note: Single source of truth for published benchmark numbers. The site imports this file, scripts/check-site.mjs validates the built site against it, and tests/benchmark-docs.test.mjs fails the suite if README.md, AGENTS.md, or the manifest version drift from it. Numbers may only come from a full harness run (bench plus stress). On a release that does not touch scoring code (src fusion, preprocessing, models, probe), bump extensionVersion here to re-affirm the numbers still describe the shipped build; any release that touches scoring code requires a fresh run first.
scoringChange: v1.4.0 never sheds TTA to center-only, raises TTA_EARLY_EXIT from 0.85 to 0.95, and requires DINO >= 0.96 after an agreement fallback. The 893/240/132/100 fixtures are not in git. The bench, stress, liveGuard, and productGuard numbers below are the last published v1.3.2 adaptive-path run and were not re-scored in this checkout.

stress.description: Full-resolution stock, catalog, product, interior, and high-saturation real photos; remaining FPs are CommunityForensics alone at >= 0.65 where it is authoritative

legacyRawMax.reason: Unacceptable live false positives on stock and catalog images

liveGuard.description: Held-out camera-EXIF Unsplash editorial photos fetched as live CDN bytes (AVIF and JPEG grid variants, w=700 q=60); v1.2.0 measured 9.2 percent on this distribution

productGuard.description: Held-out IKEA and Amazon product-CDN images at grid and large variants; product marketing imagery counts as not generative AI for this detector. Two of three FPs are CF-driven.

runnableLiveGuard.description: Held-out unsplash-lite rows 80-149 re-fetched as live imgix grid bytes (w=700 q=60 fit=crop fm=jpg), plus 16 DALL-E 3 images. Built with eval/fetch-live-guard.mjs. Product and Flux sources returned zero files in this checkout.
